composition_label: Sentiment & prioritization -> Behavioral personalization -> Normal research

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in this isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Exact fields: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, as_of (timezone-aware ISO timestamp), customer_id, feedback[], events[], catalog[], sources[]. Entity fields are documented by example_input.json and validate_input.
shared_schema.output: One envelope: schema_version, status=ok, synthetic=true, input, sentiment, behavior, research. Each stage extends the validated previous envelope without mutating it.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate gateway enforces exact input keys, scalar types, finite bounded popularity, unique collection IDs, customer scope, category/product references, event kinds, severity enum, timezone awareness, and no future events. Boundary outputs are recomputed against deterministic stage contracts.
shared_schema.errors: CLI validation, decoding, usage, and file errors print one JSON object with status=error and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Sentiment supplies scored issues, priorities, categories, and feedback IDs to behavior; negative or high/critical issues add category attention.
Behavior supplies selected top-three product IDs, order, scores, and issue IDs to research; product metadata and linked feedback construct lexical retrieval queries.
Research preserves product order, behavior scores, issue IDs, and exact source passages with source ID, title and end-exclusive Unicode character offsets.

behavior.sentiment: Fixed English lexicon with transparent per-token evidence; odd negation count in previous three word tokens flips a contribution. Severity base 10/35/65/90 plus negative bonus capped at 10; overall cap 100. Priority descending, ID ascending ties.
behavior.personalization: Browse weight 1, purchase weight 3; decay 1/(1+age_days/30), direct item weight plus 0.25 category affinity plus max relevant priority/100 plus popularity*0.1. Rounded to eight decimals, ties by product ID.
behavior.cold_start: With no events, use severity-aware issue attention plus popularity; without issues, popularity then stable ID. No purchase exclusion.
behavior.research: Blank-line passages ranked by unique ASCII lexical term overlap excluding a small stopword set. Top two positive-overlap passages per selected product, ties by source ID and offset. Findings are exact excerpts, never generated paraphrases. Missing evidence is explicit.
behavior.empty_data: Empty collections accepted when references remain valid; empty catalog yields no ranked products or research results.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: All example entities and source texts are clearly labeled synthetic.

test_outcomes.example_cli_stdout: One valid JSON object with status=ok
